name: Eureka Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Eureka Industries Ltd does trading and dealing in agriculture commodities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EIL deals in agricultural commodities. Its trading portfolio includes wheat, rice, paddy, maize and pulses. Further, the company gradually plans to cultivate agricultural produce of all descriptions 
like fruits, vegetables, seeds, cereals, pulses, grains, rice, lentils, cash crops, corn, hay, and straw using methods.
